snippet.title: ASTBALL - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
"Fly a spaceship through deep space and survive as long as you can!
Asteroids appear in your path — shoot them to earn points.
Large asteroids break into smaller pieces when hit.
Destroy the smallest ones to score even more!

But be careful: if any asteroid piece crashes into your ship, it’s game over.
Stay alert, keep moving, and test your reflexes in this fast-paced space shooter!"

Developed by Xitilon
Also released for PlayStation 5

#ps4 #playstation4 #xitilon #astball #theforeseenarcade
